title: effectsize: Estimation of Effect Size Indices and Standardized Parameters
authors: Ben-Shachar, M., Lüdecke, D., & Makowski, D.
summary: effectsize computes and converts effect size indices — Cohen's d, Hedges' g, eta-squared, odds ratios and the rest — and standardises model parameters, with interpretation rules attached so that a number does not have to be looked up in a textbook before it can be read.
